1.why: Sans-serif typeface with clear line spacing and generous padding is used throughout; letter spacing is default but headings and labels are legible.

2.why: No italics or dense paragraphs appear, and body text is short, though small all-caps are used for 'NORTHSTAR BANK' and the 'Step 2 of 3' label.

3.why: The layout is a single narrow centred column that would likely reflow acceptably, but all screenshots are desktop-width (1280px) so mobile rendering is unverified.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Enter the six-digit code sent to your phone' are one or two short plain-language sentences.

5.why: Only the phone field shows a format example (+447700900000); the email and verification code fields have no placeholder or sample input.

6.why: No screen requires reading more than two short sentences to proceed, though the 'Logs' panel adds extraneous developer text.

7.why: No copy button or copyable secret is shown anywhere; the flow never reaches an OTP secret or recovery code screen in the screenshots.

8.why: No QR code or authenticator-setup screen is present in any of the five screenshots.

9.why: Standard HTML inputs are used which may allow autofill, but no visible autocomplete affordance or one-time-code support is evidenced.

10.why: 'Step 2 of 3' plus a bold heading and a single high-contrast primary button make the current step and main action stand out.

11.why: Later steps ask for one code, but step 1 requests two fields and each screen also carries a secondary link and a Logs panel competing for attention.

12.why: The only feedback observed is a vague 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' with no statement of what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The user can retype the code and 'Use different details', but no reveal/hide toggle or visible 'resend code' option is offered.

14.why: The error banner is non-blaming but states neither the specific problem nor how to fix it.

15.why: A 10-minute code expiry is imposed and no countdown, extension, or resend affordance is shown, though no reading timer exists.
